title: Edmund and the Postcards
author: Edmund Pemberton
blurb: Ines Almeida, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
